issue_context.title: [4.4-beta.1] Game editor not embedded due to parameters for it being after `main_run_args` and `--`.
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- v4.4.beta1.mono.official [d33da79d3]

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta1.mono - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6614) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e50686f4-088b-4fe1-9e96-f4b7f82c6126)

To speed up playtesting iterations, I created a feature to test scenes with their own arbitrary execution argument options, and at the time, I made it clear to distinguish them from the Godot engine's execution arguments by putting in parameters with just `--`.
After updating the project to `4.4-beta.1`, I realized that the Game Editor was not embedding only when I started playtesting with the features I had created and started investigating the issue.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d7ad4808-97bc-4a24-851c-630e61e24677)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c040191-3ad5-43d0-a96f-9c8c7e8954b4)

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/d33da79d3f8fe84be2521d25b9ba8e440cf25a88/editor/plugins/game_view_plugin.cpp#L566-L603

I noticed that the parameters that seem to be needed for handling window embedding in the Game editor added in 4.4 go after `main_run_args`.
I suspect this was caused by the function not working properly because it was blocked by the `--` that separates Godot arguments.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create or open any project.
- Open project settings and turn on advanced settings then find `main_run_args`. (`editor/run/main_run_args`)
- Put `--` in `main_run_args` and start play test.
- You can see game window are separated from game editor window.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[game-editor-window-not-embedded-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18455857/game-editor-window-not-embedded-mrp.zip)
comments: Thanks for testing/reporting the issue, I'll look into it, should be easy to fix. Did not thought about the `--`.

review_comments: Note: `insert_before` handle `nullptr` as `push_back`, so it's fine if it's not set.
At first, I used a` if(user_args_element) push_back else insert_before` then I saw at `insert_before` handles `nullptr` as you said. Would it be preferable to manage the `nullptr` here?
